item.title: China attackers deployed AI agents that autonomously found and exploited a 0-day to take over a university server

item.title: Amazon says Chinese hackers used Cairn AI tool to discover apparent zero-day during attack on university
item.description: A China-linked threat actor used the open source AI penetration testing tool Cairn to persistently attack two universities, and in one case, possibly discover a zero-day bug, researchers said.

item.title: Mapping the AI threat landscape: MITRE ATLAS comes to Elastic Security
item.description: Elastic Security 9.6 adds MITRE ATLAS to our detection rules and the tools you use to manage them, so you can see which AI attacks your rules already cover.
